units.title: SG-3 Add lighting and atmosphere effects
Act: Add lighting effect schema variants and author them in bedroom.yaml
Act: Render moonlight shaft, lamp glow, door light and vignette in the Phaser effect context
Act: Add destroyEffects and use it in the BootScene shutdown handler
Verify: Lighting effect schema and bedroom content unit tests

tests.name: lightingEffectsSchema: accepts a scene carrying one of each new lighting effect
tests.title: accepts a scene carrying one of each new lighting effect
tests.scenario: Given a valid scene with moonlightShaft, lampGlow, doorLight and vignette effects, When validated as scene content, Then validation succeeds
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/lightingEffectsSchema.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: lightingEffectsSchema: rejects a lampGlow with a negative radius and points at effects.0
tests.title: rejects a lampGlow with a negative radius and points at effects.0
tests.scenario: Given a scene whose first effect is a lampGlow with radius -1, When validated, Then validation fails and errors[0].path starts with effects.0
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/lightingEffectsSchema.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: bedroomLightingContent: declares moonlightShaft, lampGlow, doorLight, vignette, dust, ambientLight effects on the bedroom scene
tests.title: declares moonlightShaft, lampGlow, doorLight, vignette, dust, ambientLight effects on the bedroom scene
tests.scenario: Given the bedroom scene loaded from bundled content, When its effect types are collected, Then all six lighting effect types are present
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/lightingContentPalette.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: bedroomLightingContent: uses only palette colours for every effect that declares a colour
tests.title: uses only palette colours for every effect that declares a colour
tests.scenario: Given the bedroom scene effects, When each effect with a colour is checked against PALETTE, Then the scene has coloured effects and every colour is in PALETTE
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/lightingContentPalette.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: Phaser effect context renders lighting effects with mocked scene

tests.name: moonlightShaft renders a blended rectangle at depth 400 and destroys it
tests.title: moonlightShaft: places a blended rectangle at the authored area with depth 400 and destroys it
tests.scenario: Given a fake scene, when a moonlightShaft spec with depth 400 is created, then add.rectangle receives the area and color, setDepth(400) is called, and destroy() destroys the object
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/effectContext.test.ts -t moonlightShaft

tests.name: lampGlow renders an additive circle at depth 400 and destroys it
tests.title: lampGlow: places an additive circle at the lamp position with depth 400 and destroys it
tests.scenario: Given a fake scene, when a lampGlow spec with depth 400 is created, then add.circle receives x, y, radius, color and alpha, setDepth(400) is called, and destroy() destroys the object
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/effectContext.test.ts -t lampGlow

tests.name: doorLight renders a blended rectangle at depth 400 and destroys it
tests.title: doorLight: places a blended rectangle at the authored area with depth 400 and destroys it
tests.scenario: Given a fake scene, when a doorLight spec with depth 400 is created, then add.rectangle receives the area and color, setDepth(400) is called, and destroy() destroys the object
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/effectContext.test.ts -t doorLight

tests.name: vignette creates three bands at depth 400 and destroys all three
tests.title: vignette: creates three stroked bands with depth 400 and destroys all three
tests.scenario: Given a fake scene, when a vignette spec with depth 400 is created, then three rectangles are added with setDepth(400), and destroy() destroys all three
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/effectContext.test.ts -t vignette

tests.name: dust resolves its asset key and creates a particle emitter
tests.title: dust: resolves the asset key and creates a particle emitter with that key
tests.scenario: Given a resolveKey stub returning '<id>-key', when a dust spec is created, then resolveKey is called with 'dust', add.particles receives 'dust-key', and destroy() destroys the emitter
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/effectContext.test.ts -t dust

units.title: Verify: buildEffects depth, per-type creation and destroyEffects unit tests

tests.name: buildEffects lighting > calls createEffect once per non-transition lighting spec, each on the effects layer depth
tests.title: calls createEffect once per non-transition lighting spec, each on the effects layer depth
tests.scenario: Given a fake context and a scene with dust, ambientLight, moonlightShaft, lampGlow, doorLight, vignette and a transition; When buildEffects runs; Then createEffect is called 6 times with depth layerDepth('effects') in authored order and the transition is not played
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/buildEffectsLighting.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: destroyEffects > still calls destroy on the remaining handles when the first destroy throws
tests.title: still calls destroy on the remaining handles when the first destroy throws
tests.scenario: Given three handles where the first destroy throws; When destroyEffects runs; Then it does not throw and all three destroy spies are called once
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/buildEffectsLighting.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: BootScene effects > passes the handles returned by buildEffects to destroyEffects when the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.title: passes the handles returned by buildEffects to destroyEffects when the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.scenario: Given buildEffects returns two handles during create(); When the registered SHUTDOWN callback fires; Then destroyEffects is called with exactly those handles
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneEffects.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: BootScene effects > destroys every effect handle returned by buildEffects when the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.title: destroys every effect handle returned by buildEffects when the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.scenario: Given buildEffects returns two handles with destroy spies; When SHUTDOWN fires; Then each handle's destroy is called once through the real destroyEffects
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneEffects.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: REQ · Scene content declares moonlight shaft, lamp glow, door light and vignette with palette colours
REQ · Phaser effect context renders each lighting effect on the effects layer and destroys it
REQ · buildEffects places all effects on the effects layer and a helper destroys them on shutdown
Evidence: Lighting and atmosphere effects unit tests pass
